# Crates

Generated by `loom-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 20 packages. None is on a registry; depend on them by Git or by path.

## Components

The packages an application or an operator uses. An embedding depends on `b10x-loom-sdk`, which re-exports the runtime crates; the test kit and the conformance target serve adapter authors and the gate.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `b10x-loom-cli` | [`crates/loom-cli`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-cli) | `use b10x_loom_cli`, binary `b10x-loom` | The b10x-loom command line: route an intent to a protocol and run it until it is blocked. |
| `b10x-loom-commission` | [`crates/loom-commission`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-commission) | `use b10x_loom_commission` | Commission's contracts and runtime: the responsibility model generated from ESS, the ports an embedder implements, admission and revalidation, and the loop that drives a commission until it is blocked. |
| `b10x-loom-commission-conformance` | [`crates/loom-commission-conformance`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-commission-conformance) | `use b10x_loom_commission_conformance` | The Rust ESS conformance target that holds b10x-loom-commission to its synthesized suite. |
| `b10x-loom-commission-testkit` | [`crates/loom-commission-testkit`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-commission-testkit) | `use b10x_loom_commission_testkit` | Fakes of the Commission ports and conformance kits for adapters. |
| `b10x-loom-conformance` | [`crates/loom-conformance`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-conformance) | `use b10x_loom_conformance` | The Rust ESS conformance target that holds b10x-loom-executor to the suite synthesized from Loom's run domain. |
| `b10x-loom-connectors` | [`crates/loom-connectors`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-connectors) | `use b10x_loom_connectors` | Commission's ConnectorInvoker over a Connectors service: invokes a bound Connector operation once and reports the attempt Connectors recorded. |
| `b10x-loom-executor` | [`crates/loom-executor`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-executor) | `use b10x_loom_executor` | The Loom executor: Commission's AgentExecutor over a projected catalogue, with action selection kept apart from argument generation, and the ported Harness model wires, turn loop and sessions. |
| `b10x-loom-governor` | [`crates/loom-governor`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-governor) | `use loom_governor` | Evaluates a case's protocol with Canon behind the governor and evidence ports Commission defines. |
| `b10x-loom-intake-references` | [`crates/loom-intake-references`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-intake-references) | `use b10x_loom_intake_references` | Deterministic extraction of an intent's key references: tracker keys, chat permalinks, merge requests, pull requests and URLs. |
| `b10x-loom-intake-router` | [`crates/loom-intake-router`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-intake-router) | `use b10x_loom_intake_router` | Propose the engineering protocol an intent should run under, refusing a pick outside the registry or below a confidence threshold. |
| `b10x-loom-intake-slice` | [`crates/loom-intake-slice`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-intake-slice) | `use b10x_loom_intake_slice` | The vertical slice: open a case on the picked protocol through the governor and run Commission's runtime over it, with Loom proposing and a local effect adapter performing. |
| `b10x-loom-plugin` | [`crates/loom-plugin`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-plugin) | `use b10x_loom_plugin` | The plugin host: runs a plugin's poll, classify, project, turn and result hooks in a loop, each turn a governed read-only run over Connectors data sources, and keeps one record line per handled item. |
| `b10x-loom-plugin-slack` | [`crates/loom-plugin-slack`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-plugin-slack) | `use b10x_loom_plugin_slack` | The slack-handler plugin: walks the Slack channels the bot is a member of through the Connectors command line, read only, and hands the host the messages nobody answered, mentions first. |
| `b10x-loom-protocols` | [`crates/loom-protocols`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-protocols) | `use loom_protocols` | Composes trusted protocol definitions and installs pinned data-only custom sources. |
| `b10x-loom-sdk` | [`crates/loom-sdk`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-sdk) | `use loom_sdk` | One crate an application depends on to embed a governed agent: Commission's contracts and runtime, the Loom executor, the governor and intake, re-exported. |
| `b10x-loom-selector-laya` | [`crates/loom-selector-laya`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-selector-laya) | `use b10x_loom_selector_laya` | An experimental fast typed action selector: asks a local or hosted Laya endpoint to choose one action of the candidate set and reports its probability as confidence, never as authority. |

## Repository tooling

Generators and checks the repository's own gate runs. Nothing outside the repository depends on them.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `loom-commission-docs` | [`crates/loom-commission-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-commission-docs) | binary `loom-commission-docs` | Generates the Commission reference pages of the Loom documentation site and checks them for drift. |
| `loom-commission-xtask` | [`crates/loom-commission-xtask`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-commission-xtask) | binary `loom-commission-xtask` | Repository checks for Commission: generated-model drift and hand-written model types. |
| `loom-docs` | [`crates/loom-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-docs) | binary `loom-docs` | Generates the derived pages of the Loom documentation site (CLI, crates, ESS reference) and checks them for drift. |
| `loom-xtask` | [`crates/loom-xtask`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/tree/main/crates/loom-xtask) | binary `loom-xtask` | Repository checks for Loom: generated-model drift, hand-written model types and release tags. |
